transcript_segments.text: i have a confession which is annoying because lately i've been trying not to turn every
good day into a courtroom
but here it is
i feel good
suspicious i know
ten years back i was basically a weather warning with shoes
low pressure in the hallway heavy chances of not replying
small craft advisory for anyone trying to love me before noon
i wore the end of the world like a winter coat buttoned it wrong slept in it called
it realism
and now now i wake up and make little things
a tiny app for a friend who forgets their groceries
a dumb little game where the frog is sad but financially responsible
a song like this which is cheaper than therapy and less likely to ask about my childhood
with a clipboard
and somehow that makes people nervous
like joy is only valid if it arrives by hand covered in mud with references
i know the room is worried
i can hear the sirens hum
but i found a little doorway where i used to find a wall
maybe it's not on fire
maybe it's not on flood
maybe i'm allowed to feel alive without betraying anyone
maybe i can keep my eyes open and still let the morning come
maybe it's not all ruined
maybe some things help someone
i said maybe
please lower the pitchfork to a conversational angle
everybody keeps telling me be careful which is fair
i am careful
i check the label
i check the lock
i check the thing that checks the thing and worry
the checker has hobbies
i don't trust a ladder just because it reaches higher
i test the rung
i shake the frame
i keep one hand on ordinary doubt
but there's a difference between caution and throwing away the window because sunlight
has historically been rude
they say it'll make you lazy which is funny because i have learned more in two strange
years than 20 respectable ones where i sat politely beside my own confusion and called
it discipline
now when i don't understand something i can ask badly repeatedly at midnight with examples
with follow up questions that would make a teacher stare out the window and reconsider
cheese farming
and yes sometimes the answer wears a fake mustache so check
but sometimes it opens a door i didn't know had hinges
maybe it's not all fire
maybe it's not all flood
maybe i'm allowed to feel lighter without betraying anyone
maybe i can keep my eyes open and still let the morning come
maybe it's not all ruin
maybe some things help someone
and yes i hear the warnings
i hear the power bills
the server farms
the men in expensive jackets promising the future with very hydrated faces
i hear the teachers die at the r to scare the workers asking if the ladder is being
pulled up while everyone claps for the elevator
i hear it
i'm not asking you to stop worrying
i'm asking if there is room inside the worry for one ordinary person who is drowning quietly
and found a tool that helped them breathe long enough to make something kind for somebody
else
is that allowed
or do i need to be miserable again for the argument to stay tidy
because i remember when everything felt finished not dramatic finished just dishes in the
sink finished one red message finished standing in a shop aisle holding two kinds of rice
and feeling unqualified to continue as a person finished
and now i make things small things no empire no prophecy no blowing portal just a friend
says could it remind me
and i say maybe
just the melody catches on a bad afternoon and i follow in until the beam stops biting
just a question used to shame me turns into a staircase
and i know stairs can lead anywhere
basements included
so i bring a torch i'm bringing that i bring back the plans and the suspicious little face
but i'm still going
not because everything is safe
because not everything that helps you has to be holy
not everything dangerous is useless
not every new door is a trap
just because the old ones were honest about hurting
maybe it's not all fire
maybe it's not all flood
maybe i'm allowed to feel fire
without betraying anyone
maybe i can keep my eyes open and still let the morning come
maybe it's not all ruin
maybe some things help someone
maybe it's not all endless
maybe i'm not wrong for building little bridges out of questions and songs
maybe i can stay careful
it's still not coming done
maybe it's not all ruin
maybe some things help someone
so yes i feel good
i'm checking exits
i'm reading small print
i'm keeping my doubts well fed and hydrated
but for once when the world says be afraid
i can say i am
and also look what i made
